subject: website
name: Immutable Frontends
summary: Immutable Frontends, a registry of verified decentralised frontends. Its source is public (no licence file). It is not Level 3: when it opens it loads a script from cdn.gpteng.co, the Lovable site builder's, which the user is not told about. Its registry data comes from The Graph's gateway.
